159.news_title: The Easiest Way to Replace a Vewlix Arcade Monitor
159.long_description: Wanting to upgrade or replace a faulty Vewlix arcade monitor is super easy with the Arcooda all in one 32inch Arcooda monitor with complete metal frame package. There is little technical knowledge needed as our product has been designed for all Taito Vewlix, and the Arcooda Game Wizard Xtreme machine series. If the Chewlix machines are designed based on the Vewlix, then this monitor bundle is a perfect solution. Why is our Arcooda monitor the easiest way to replace a Vewlix monitor? 1) simply dismantle your old monitor/frame from your Vewlix machine. 2) using the same mounting holes/screws, reattach the Arcooda 32inch monitor with frame into the cabinet. And that's it - no need for special brackets, modifications, or extra stress. 3) if you are running older JAMMA and JVS games, there is NO NEED to purchase scalers such as Gonbes GBS-8200, OSSC, RetroTink and other scaler boxes. Our monitor supports native 15khz, 24khz and 31khz on plug and play basis via our RGB/VGA board interface. 4) with over 160 pre-set video resolutions, our monitor also supports not only older Sega, Namco, and Taito games, but PC video resolutions up to 1080p. 5) our monitor has been designed for arcade game play, with full viewing angle (178 degree), and low monitor lag (1.3ms), its the perfect all round solution for your old retro games, as well are all current series arcade games. The full monitor and metal frame with glass panel, is available for purchase and is used exclusively on all Arcooda Game Wizard Xtreme 3.0 machines.
